AccessToken.description: Access token of the client application.

Client.description: Name and version of the client application.

Limitation.description: Limitation on the quantity of data returned and optional Cursor for the starting point of data.

EnterpriseIds.description: Unique identifiers of the Enterprises. If not specified, the operation returns data for all enterprises within scope of the Access Token.

PaymentIds.description: Unique identifiers of specific `Payment` items. Required if no other filter is provided.

AccountIds.description: Unique identifiers of specific `Accounts` to which payments belong. Required if no other filter is provided.

BillIds.description: Unique identifiers of specific `Bill` items to which payments are assigned. Required if no other filter is provided.

ReservationIds.description: Unique identifiers of specific `Reservations` to which payments belong. Required if no other filter is provided.

CreatedUtc.title: Time interval
CreatedUtc.description: Time interval during which the `Payment` was created. Required if no other filter is provided.

UpdatedUtc.title: Time interval
UpdatedUtc.description: Time interval during which the `Payment` was updated. Required if no other filter is provided.

ChargedUtc.title: Time interval
ChargedUtc.description: Time interval during which the `Payment` was charged. Required if no other filter is provided.

ClosedUtc.title: Time interval
ClosedUtc.description: Time interval during which the `Payment` was closed. Required if no other filter is provided.

SettlementUtc.title: Time interval
SettlementUtc.description: Interval in which the `Payments` were settled.

Currency.description: ISO-4217 code of the `Currency` the item costs should be converted to.

Type.description:
Payment state of the item.
